definitions.explanation: exercising power in a selfish and arbitrary manner, ignoring others' rights or proper procedures

notes:
{専横|せんおう} describes the abuse of power in an arbitrary, selfish manner, ignoring proper procedures or others' rights.

WRITING:
- {専|せん} (exclusive, solely, monopolize)
- {横|おう} (sideways; unreasonable, arbitrary)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Used as noun: {専横|せんおう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{許|ゆる}さない→許す：02325_yurusu⟧ (not allow despotism)
- Used as na-adjective: {専横|せんおう}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a despotic person)
- {専横|せんおう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{極|きわ}める→極める：13139_kiwameru⟧ (to be extremely despotic)
- {専横|せんおう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧ (to become despotic)
- {専横|せんおう}な⟦{支配|しはい}→支配：01421_shihai⟧ (despotic rule)

USAGE:
- Stronger and more formal than ⟦{横暴|おうぼう}→横暴：07988_oubou⟧
- Often used in political/historical contexts
- Implies abuse of power and disregard for others

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{横暴|おうぼう}→横暴：07988_oubou⟧ - tyranny, high-handedness
- ⟦{独断|どくだん}→独断：08658_dokudan⟧ - arbitrary decision
- {独善|どくぜん} - self-righteousness
